audit_result_in_one_paragraph: No blocker and no major defect. Every number on the deck was verified twice, once mechanically by the operator against the byte-exact thesis tables and once independently by a web call, with zero exceptions across 136 items on slides 6 to 13. Chart geometry was measured directly from the PDF drawing objects and every plotted point lands within a hundredth of a point. All twelve citations exist with the correct year and support the proposition they are attached to. No slide asserts causation, claims an established mechanism, or reads the payment-method result as strict cash specificity. What remains is four cosmetic wording items and one substantial exposure in the question period that is not a deck problem.

speaker_notes_brief_when_that_work_start.scope: All 13 main-deck slides. The Q&A appendix is separate and later.
speaker_notes_brief_when_that_work_start.time_budget: 18 minutes with a 2 minute buffer inside a hard 20 minute limit. Sections are 5 minutes for slides 1 to 5, 10 minutes for slides 6 to 10, and 3 minutes for slides 11 to 13.
speaker_notes_brief_when_that_work_start.word_budget_method: Do not invent a per-slide time. Measure the presenter's own speaking rate on two timed passages, take the lower clean rate, and multiply by 17 minutes to leave a minute for pauses and navigation. Allocate by the 5:10:3 section ratio.
speaker_notes_brief_when_that_work_start.grounding_rule: Every academic sentence and every number in the notes must trace to an exact thesis file and location. Where the thesis is silent, the notes must say so rather than fill the gap.
speaker_notes_brief_when_that_work_start.hard_constraint: The notes may explain the visible slide. They may not add a result, a mechanism, a causal claim, or an appendix-only analysis to the main talk.
speaker_notes_brief_when_that_work_start.committee_context: One examiner prefers defenses that finish promptly, so a tight findings-forward delivery matters more than completeness.

untested_and_owed: The deck has never been rehearsed or timed. The 18 minute target is a design assumption, not a measured fact. Only the presenter can close this.
No adversarial second reviewer ran over the claims and examiner passes, so their completeness rests on a single read each. The mechanical dimensions do not share this limitation.
The thesis itself was not audited. It is submitted and approved and out of scope. A faithful deck reproducing a thesis error would pass every check here.

built_this_session: Correction rounds, so a delivery that fails validation is repaired in the same conversation instead of costing a fresh call
Parallel calls, each bound to its own tab, with a file lock around all shared state
Filename allocation, so two calls can never claim the same deliverable name
web_call_infrastructure.operational_rule_learned_the_hard_way: Download every returned file before clicking Done and validate. Done stops monitoring, and anything that arrives afterwards is not collected. Recovery is to copy the files into the exchange response directory and run validate --exchange.
